item.description:
- Use the right singular and plural words in every language, and group large counts in Louppe's language so they are easier to read. - Show the next photo sooner when browsing, with faster fitted previews and lower memory use. - Keep Louppe responsive while checking folders opened from Finder, the Dock or a drop. - Offer Try Again if a video's audio or subtitle options cannot be loaded. - Keep Clean Up's menu commands responsive in large folders. - Align menus, dialog actions and status messages across review, Export, Rename and Organize. Give VoiceOver clearer labels for camera settings and photo quality warnings. - Report failed XMP sidecar checks in Export with Try Again, preserving the XMP choice until a check succeeds. - Keep the Rename and Organize sheet title visible while files move. - Give Sort, Filter, quality-cue and review-status popovers one surface, arrow included: no lighter arrow or seam, and legible over bright photos.
- Show the normal toolbar, Browser and Info panel while a large folder opens, with controls greyed out until all photo details load, so the view no longer jumps when review begins. - Filter dates by Range, Year or Date in a full-width chooser; each mode keeps its choices when you switch. - Drop the status-bar filter menu; the purple Filter button already shows an active filter. Sort now turns purple too when it differs from your default or Duplicates/Similar review is on. - Remove brief stalls of up to 0.1 seconds while photo details load in folders with tens of thousands of photos. - Line up Connected drives with Pinned folders on the start screen when there are no recent folders, instead of showing them off-center. - Show a thick purple line where a dragged row will land when reordering Rename filename parts or Organize folder levels. - Center the Grid's Play button on the video again; since 1.13 it sat near the top edge of wide clips. - Rename Files numbers files that would share a name instead of blocking: with only Date taken, each day's files become 2026.02.20_001, _002, and so on. Unique names stay unchanged.
- Keep Undo from moving a file that another app changed or replaced after Rename or Organize. - Offer Undo when Rename or Organize finishes with some files left unchanged. - Keep the current photo in view in Browser and Grid after sorting or resizing the window. - Apply a just-typed search before decisions, stars and color labels, so they never reach photos the search hides.
